title: Incorporating the Knowledge Distillation to Improve the EfficientNet Transfer Learning Capability
abstract: arXiv:2611.34025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Due to the Deep Learning requirement for a large training dataset, Transfer Learning has become a central method in the field of Computer Vision, which heavily used Deep Learning. Since the adoption of transfer learning in the field, the performance of the models in computer vision is significantly upgraded. The common transfer learning practice in computer vision research is to use state-of-the-art architectures in the ImageNet dataset as the backbone network. The best performing architecture in ImageNet is currently held by EfficientNet, which is a set of architectures that were progressively grown from a baseline architecture.   By observing the EfficientNet development approach, it is natural to hypothesize that the smaller EfficientNet architecture is capable to contain the knowledge of the larger architecture. translated_title: 融入知识蒸馏以提升EfficientNet的迁移学习能力
translated_abstract: 由于深度学习需要大量的训练数据集，迁移学习已成为大量应用深度学习的计算机视觉领域的核心方法。自该领域采用迁移学习以来，计算机视觉模型的性能得到了显著提升。计算机视觉研究中常见的迁移学习实践是使用在ImageNet数据集上表现最先进的架构作为骨干网络。目前在ImageNet上表现最佳的架构是EfficientNet，它是一组从基线架构逐步扩展（增长）而来的架构。通过观察EfficientNet的发展方式，可以很自然地假设较小的EfficientNet架构能够包含较大架构的知识。这一假设源于这样一个事实：较大的EfficientNet架构是从小架构逐步增长而来的。
tldr: 本文提出将知识蒸馏融入EfficientNet的迁移学习过程中，利用较大EfficientNet架构中蕴含的知识来提升较小架构的迁移学习能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incorporating knowledge distillation into EfficientNet transfer learning, leveraging the knowledge embedded in larger EfficientNet architectures to enhance the transfer learning capability of smaller architectures.
